title: John Harbaugh: We're "honing in" on who will start at QB in Week 7

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Harbaugh: We're "honing in" on who will start at QB in Week 7
sources.description: The Giants' HC said the team is working through who will start at QB after J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston late in Sunday's game and played well.
